designer_note: PUBLIC TABLE (ADR-0015): copied to the client verbatim. Which mineral each deposit holds and its reserve live in the server-only data/world/deposit-reserves/cradle.json, so nothing here reveals a deposit before its first extraction (design p1-02 section 3.2). Positions are system_local metres (ADR-0009 section 1) and were checked against cradle.json: every deposit is inside the soft boundary, clear of the star and Vela, and at least 825 m from the nearest spawn point. display_name is deliberately region-only so the label does not give away the mineral. Split from schema_version 1 on 2026-10-05 without changing any value.
